notes.title: Thank you for playtesting!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!! I'd like to thank everyone that has playtested the game so far, your support and understanding has been really heartwarming to see, It means a bunch!

For everyone encountering bugs and crashes, I've tried to fix a few that are doable in such a small timeframe but unfortunately I won't be able to attack every bug by the end of the playtest, as some need complete code rewrites. 
I am aware of the gunshop mechanics and selling weapons are one of the bigger issues in the playtest, and that is the one that I won't be able to tackle in time, I am very sorry.
 
But hey, that means when the game comes out in full release, those bugs will be squashed thanks to you!

Have a great rest of your week everyone!

notes.title: Playtest hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Version 0.2:
-Fixed main menu not working correctly
-Fixed crash in tutorial sequence
-Fixed mouse click activating button no matter where you clicked

That's it for day 1, thanks everyone who has played so far, very sorry for the inconvenient crash in the tutorial section, should be fixed now!

notes.title: Playtest hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Version 0.1:
-Closed gun merchant room
-Fixed items only dropping adrenaline shots
-Fixed room near item shop looping

This little hotfix is one of maybe many during this playtest.
The game is expected to have bugs and crashes during this playtest, please be patient! I'll try to fix as many bugs as i can.

Thanks for playing and helping me out!
